name: Luminous Aurora & Multi-Layered Frosted Glass
designThesis: Sophisticated optical depth model utilizing multi-layer backdrop blurs, luminous ambient aurora gradient backplanes, and translucent border highlights, verified mathematically to ensure underlying backdrops never compromise foreground text contrast.
bestFitContexts: Modern AI creative studios and generation suites
Premium audio streaming and spatial media consoles
High-end lifestyle and fintech wealth management apps
SaaS modal navigation overlays and floating inspector panels
poorFitContexts: Low-power or resource-constrained embedded browser devices
Plain text legal registries and accessibility-critical government services

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Deep atmospheric navy or warm translucent slate with chromatic underglows
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Vibrant chromatic accents (Electric Violet #8B5CF6, Bright Cyan #06B6D4) blended into blurred background surfaces
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Strict minimum 4.5:1 AA with composited background luminance calculation

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit paired with clean modern sans
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Clean geometric headings with medium-weight card titles and high-legibility body copy

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Floating bento grid layout with generous 24px container gaps
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Spacious card margins and breathable padding

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px hairline border with translucent white/cyan gradient (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15))
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Multi-layered z-index composition with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) and subtle specular highlight

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Luminous pill button with subtle internal highlight and smooth scale hover physics
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Frosted glass containers with diffuse backdrop blur and dark-surface fallbacks
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Translucent table headers with frosted sticky positioning over scrolling rows

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Distinct solid focus ring (3px) preventing blur interference with focus indicator
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Fallback to solid opaque backgrounds when transparency or blur is disabled

antiPatterns: Placing low-contrast text over uncomposited, fluctuating aurora gradients
Over-stacking backdrop filters causing GPU frame drops on mobile devices
Omitting solid background fallbacks for browsers without backdrop-filter support
Text shadows that blur into the background

browserChecks: Verify backdrop-filter blur performance on mobile viewports
Verify text contrast against composite aurora layers
